requirements.title: Deterministic GitHub-native control plane
requirements.summary: GitHub owns delivery identity, deterministic planning, risk and execution policy; AI is a bounded worker, not the orchestrator.

requirements.title: Deterministic provider dispatch with no silent fallback
requirements.summary: Provider+risk resolves to one pinned worker; missing auth or dispatch failure fails closed and never substitutes another provider.

requirements.title: Safe-output AI workers and credential isolation
requirements.summary: AI workers receive read capability and bounded safe outputs; write credentials are not exposed to agent shell execution.

requirements.title: Risk profiles, hard budgets and bounded provider work
requirements.summary: FAST/STANDARD/CRITICAL define CI depth, audit policy, implementation attempts, turns and AI-credit ceilings; deterministic pre-material recovery may replace an eligible lost attempt without increasing those ceilings.

requirements.title: Adaptive CI core and reusable risk output contract
requirements.summary: A deterministic classifier selects focused, affected or full CI while caller repositories retain their concrete build/test commands.

requirements.title: Fail-closed classifier hardening for sensitive boundaries
requirements.summary: FAST is a strict safe allowlist; authentication, authorization, session, identity, permissions, sensitive boundaries and unknown paths cannot be downgraded by convenient filenames or extensions.

requirements.title: Versioned classifier distribution and repository-specific promotion policy
requirements.summary: Public/private target repositories consume a generated, fingerprinted policy snapshot from the private orchestrator; overrides may promote risk or add reviewed safe roots but cannot weaken core invariants.

requirements.title: GitHub-native independent audit contract
requirements.summary: Independent audit consumes exact GitHub candidate identity and CI evidence directly; a legacy .audit handoff is not mandatory for normal V2 deliveries.

requirements.title: Bounded remediation state machine
requirements.summary: Actionable CI/audit findings re-enter a deterministic, attempt-bounded remediation loop; exhausted budgets escalate to humans. Persistent material hygiene UNKNOWN escalates without authorizing candidate mutation or consuming CI/audit remediation budgets.

requirements.title: Exact-head release gate
requirements.summary: Release readiness is computed from the current PR head, required checks, risk profile and required independent review; missing or materially UNKNOWN hygiene remains technical-hygiene-pending, proven BLOCK remains bounded-remediable, and material SHA drift invalidates prior approval.

requirements.title: Observability, token/cost accounting and performance SLO evidence
requirements.summary: Every delivery records provider calls, turns/credits, attempts, CI duration, audit duration, end-to-end duration and terminal reason so V2 can be optimized from evidence. AI Usage & Cost Reporting evolves the same accumulator into a per-provider-run ledger with reported/estimated/effective cost precedence, phase/model/worker attribution, a filterable `ai:usage` CLI, a manual Job Summary/artifact workflow and non-blocking budget warnings, all derived from this single canonical source.

requirements.title: controle_calorias production pilot
requirements.summary: Adaptive CI is merged and a real FAST change proved related-test routing and material runtime reduction.

requirements.title: training-system pilot and FAST benchmark
requirements.summary: Generated adaptive routing is merged and active on develop; a real low-risk UI pilot proved the FAST path, exact-head evidence, focused gates, skipped STANDARD/CRITICAL validation and material runtime reduction. Rollout refers to the adaptive routing on the target branch and does not require merging the disposable benchmark change itself.

requirements.title: V1 and nested-Skill retirement
requirements.summary: Delivery V2 is the only active normal-path entrypoint; the legacy delivery-request queue, recursive max-cycle controller, nested-Skill orchestration, mandatory V1 handoff/certificate path and retired snapshot roots are physically absent from the active tree; only minimal provenance remains under docs/delivery-v2/history/v1 and Git history.

requirements.title: Canonical master specification and executable completeness gate
requirements.summary: The repository, not a chat transcript, is the durable source of truth for architecture, requirement status and completion.

requirements.title: Persistent resumable delivery state
requirements.summary: The deterministic controller persists candidate identity, state transitions, attempt counters and evidence pointers so a new process/chat resumes without reconstructing orchestration history from prose.

requirements.title: Technical Hygiene Gate, Reuse-First and structural regression protection
requirements.summary: Bounded Reuse Discovery, exact-SHA structural evidence and a fail-closed Technical Hygiene Gate prevent material structural regression. Mixed UNKNOWN may rearm full evidence-only collection after a verified control-plane SHA change while preserving prior semantic evidence; persistent UNKNOWN escalates without release.
